one_liner: A channel-based messaging platform for team collaboration and workflow automation.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 with scopes for user and bot tokens, or classic bot user tokens.
gate_notes: Creating an app requires a Slack account, but the developer portal is self-serve and free.
verdict_reason: Slack provides a comprehensive Web API, robust documentation, self-serve credentials, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

extras.rate_limit_note: Tiered rate limiting per method, typically ranging from 1 to 50 requests per minute.
